🇫🇷 🇱🇧 A French Soldier died today in Lebanon in an accidental shooting during training.

"Tribute to Private First Class Florian Gillet, who died this day in the fulfillment of his mission in service to France.

Engaged in Lebanon as part of an operational partnership mission for the benefit of the Lebanese Armed Forces, he was struck by accidental gunfire during the preparation of a training exercise.
 
I express the compassion of the French Army to his family, his loved ones, and his brothers-in-arms of the 8th RPIMa, with a special thought for those who continue the mission." - French Army.

🇮🇷 Last night, U.S. military strikes reportedly hit drinking water storage tanks in the Bamani district of Sirik county, Hormozgan province, Iran.

20,000 are without water.
